info.title: KubeStellar Hive API
info.description: Reference for the KubeStellar Hive Dashboard API. Covers the dashboard server's registered GET/POST/PUT/DELETE operations.

tags.name: Audit
tags.description: Recent dashboard and agent lifecycle audit entries

tags.name: Contribute
tags.description: Public contributor self-service: registration, activity, queue, fleet, and leaderboard discovery

tags.name: Inception
tags.description: Greenfield project scaffolding and ideation workflow

tags.name: Knowledge
tags.description: Knowledge base facts, vaults, git sources, documents, and channels

get.description: Returns up to 200 newest audit entries from the dashboard audit ring. Requires read-write or higher access.
Returns the full hive status including governor state, agent details, repos, queue depth, and all metrics used by the dashboard.
Returns the current git commit hash and dirty state of the hive repo.

dirty.description: Whether the working tree has uncommitted changes

get.description: Returns the project name, org, primary repo, and dashboard title.
Returns whether the token budget is currently being ignored.

post.description: Sets either the global budget-ignore-all flag ({"ignored": bool}) or the per-agent exemption list ({"ignored": [names]}), based on the JSON type of `ignored`. Requires owner role.

ignored.description: Either a boolean (global bypass) or an array of agent names (per-agent exemption list).

get.description: Returns ~120 downsampled status snapshots from the in-memory 12-hour rolling window (5s intervals). Used for sparkline charts.
Returns downsampled persistent history for the given range. Used for trend sparklines and governor mode distribution.
Returns ~200 mode snapshots over the last 24 hours for the governor timeline strip.
Returns the last 30 lines of the agent's tmux session output.
Server-Sent Events stream of real-time status updates. Each event is a JSON-encoded status snapshot.

get.summary: Token usage by agent and model
get.description: Returns token consumption data broken down by agent and model.

schema.description: Token usage keyed by agent name, with model-level breakdowns

get.description: Returns the current governor mode, budget state, and per-agent model assignments including cost weights and cadences.
Returns whether GitHub authentication is working.
Returns any active GitHub API rate limit warnings.
Returns comprehensive exec summaries (task, progress, results) for all agents.

schema.description: Keyed by agent name, each containing task summary, progress, and results

get.description: Returns the full configuration for a specific agent including cadences, models, pipeline settings, and restrictions.
Returns the CLAUDE.md prompt file for the given agent.

put.summary: Save or import an agent's kick prompt template
put.description: Owner-only. With template set (and promptSource omitted), saves the inline text as the agent's kick template file. With promptSource set to {owner,repo,path,ref}, imports the prompt from an allowlisted GitHub repo: keepLinked=true persists prompt_source for live re-resolution at kick time; keepLinked=false fetches once, bakes the content into the template file, and clears any existing prompt_source.

template.description: Inline prompt text, used when promptSource is not set.

400.description: Invalid body, missing owner/repo/path, or prompt source not allowlisted/unreachable

500.description: Failed to write the template file

get.description: Returns the list of configured stat data sources.
Returns the complete governor configuration including thresholds, labels, budget, notifications, health settings, sensing parameters, and monitored repos.
Returns the sidebar navigation layout configuration.

put.description: Persists the caller-supplied sidebar layout as-is (an arbitrary JSON value defined and interpreted entirely by the frontend) to /data/sidebar.json and in-memory state. The server does not validate or interpret its shape.

schema.description: Arbitrary sidebar layout value; shape is frontend-defined and not validated server-side.

get.description: Returns the list of available CLI backends (claude, aider, codex, etc.) and their supported models.
Returns the current Nous experiment engine state including mode, active experiment, pending proposals, snapshot progress, and recommendations.
Returns the last 200 experiment ledger entries (JSONL).
Returns the accumulated knowledge base of principles learned from experiments.
Returns the current phase and iteration for governor and repo experiments.
Returns any pending experiment gate decisions waiting for approval.
Returns the current gate response state for a given experiment.
Returns all registered contributors with their trust tier and active status.
Returns the full profile for a specific contributor including active status and current task.

delete.description: Permanently removes a contributor's stored profile file. Requires the HIVE_DASHBOARD_TOKEN dashboard auth AND the owner role (X-Hive-Role: owner, verified) — enforced in-handler via requireOwnerRole; any other role gets 403.

500.description: Failed to delete the profile file

get.description: Returns the contributor hub status including registration state.
Returns all registered hive instances including the local instance.
Returns every configured agent (managed and pack-defined) with its core identity and current backend/model.

managed.description: True for CRUD-created agents; false for base/pack-defined agents, which cannot be deleted.

post.description: Owner-only. Creates a new managed agent from an inline agent config, writes its agent file, lifts any prior deletion tombstone for the same name, and starts its process. Rejects invalid names (must be alphanumeric/hyphen/underscore, max 64 chars), invalid explain_mode/caveman_mode values, and a name that already exists (409).

name.description: New agent's name; alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores only, max 64 chars.

agent.description: Agent config fields (backend, model, display_name, mode, kick_template, etc.) — see the full AgentConfig shape returned by GET /api/config/agent/{name}.

400.description: Invalid name, missing name, invalid explain_mode/caveman_mode, or downstream validation failure

post.description: Owner-only. Creates an agent from a portable AgentDefinition YAML document, either fetched from an allowlisted GitHub/Gist URL or pasted inline. Set preview=true to parse and return the definition without creating the agent. keepLinked (source=url only) persists a definition_source so the agent's operator-safe fields re-sync from the repo on reload; gist URLs are rejected when keepLinked is true. URL fetches are restricted to github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com, gist.github.com, and gist.githubusercontent.com, with SSRF guards against private/internal addresses.

url.description: Required when source is 'url'. Max 2048 chars.

content.description: Required when source is 'paste'. The raw AgentDefinition YAML.

preview.description: When true, parse and return the definition without creating anything.

keepLinked.description: source=url only. Persists a definition_source for live re-fetch on reload.

ok.description: Present only on a preview response.

parsed.description: Present only on a preview response: the parsed AgentDefinition.

400.description: Invalid body, disallowed/unreachable/private URL, invalid or duplicate agent name, or parse failure

502.description: URL fetch failed or returned a non-200 status

delete.description: Owner-only. Deletes a managed (CRUD-created) agent's overlay file and removes it from the roster, then durably tombstones the name so a later ACMM pack apply does not silently recreate it. Base/pack-defined agents (managed=false) cannot be deleted (403). If the deleted name replicates another agent (ReplicaOf), the base agent is resolved and deleted instead.

note.description: Present when the agent is not part of any ACMM pack.

packLevels.description: Present when the agent is defined by one or more ACMM pack levels — those levels will not recreate it after this tombstone.

403.description: Owner role required, or agent is not a managed/CRUD-created agent

get.description: Lightweight, authoritative read of an agent's pause state, used by the dashboard immediately before a pause/resume toggle so the action derives from server state rather than a stale UI.

procState.description: Underlying process state (e.g. running, starting, crashed).

get.description: Read-only; any authenticated role. Returns the full retained tmux scrollback of the agent's current/latest run as plain text (tokens and device-auth codes redacted). ?download=1 sets Content-Disposition to save a .log file. ?explain=only returns just EXPLAIN-mode reasoning lines; ?explain=hide returns the log with those lines removed; any other value returns the log unfiltered.

parameters.name: download
parameters.description: Any non-empty value triggers an attachment download.

parameters.name: explain
parameters.description: Filter to (only) or exclude (hide) EXPLAIN-mode lines.

404.description: Agent not found or capture failed

get.summary: URLs visible in the agent's terminal
get.description: Read-only; any authenticated role. Returns the distinct http(s) URLs present in the agent's retained tmux scrollback, most recent first, captured with `capture-pane -J` so terminal-wrapped URLs are rejoined and copy whole. Backs the dashboard's click-to-copy control (#5188), which exists because the embedded ttyd terminal cannot complete a clipboard write. The capture is redacted before extraction and any URL still carrying a redaction marker is dropped, so device-flow login URLs (whose line carries the one-time code) do not appear. An agent with no session, or with no URL on screen, returns an empty list rather than an error.

200.description: Distinct URLs from the agent's pane, newest first (possibly empty)

get.description: Read-only; any authenticated role. Returns the agent's archived per-kick run logs, newest first. An agent with no history returns an empty array, never an error.

id.description: Archive filename; the handle used by GET .../kicks/{id}.

trigger.description: What triggered the archive: kick, restart, or shutdown.

get.description: Read-only; any authenticated role. Returns one archived kick log as plain text (tokens and device-auth codes redacted). ?download=1 sets Content-Disposition to save a .log file.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Kick log archive id, from GET .../kicks

parameters.name: download
parameters.description: Any non-empty value triggers an attachment download.

post.description:
Queues a message/prompt for delivery to the agent's running session and returns immediately. If no prompt/message is given, an auto-generated message is built from the agent's last actionable item.

ASYNCHRONOUS (kubestellar/hive#5325). Delivery waits for the CLI's input prompt, which can take up to 120s and therefore used to outlive a typical 60s ingress idle timeout, making a proxy answer 504 for a kick that actually succeeded. Fast, deterministic preconditions (unknown agent, paused, stopped, missing tmux session) are still evaluated inline and still return 400. Everything slower runs in the background; poll GET /api/kick/{agent}/status for the delivery outcome.

Delivery is exactly-once per agent: a second POST while a delivery is in flight is deduplicated and answers status "in-flight" without typing the prompt again.

202.description: Kick queued for delivery. Not a delivery confirmation.

status.description: queued: this call started a delivery. in-flight: a delivery for this agent was already running and this call was deduplicated.

message.description: Present on the in-flight path, explaining the deduplication.

400.description: Prompt too long, or the kick failed its preconditions (unknown agent, paused, stopped, no tmux session)

post.description: Sets and persists the agent's model override, claims operator ownership of the field (so a pack re-apply on restart cannot revert it), and restarts the agent's session so the change takes effect immediately. Rejects a model the agent's effective backend does not serve.

400.description: Model not available for the agent's backend, or SetModelOverride failed

post.description: Owner-only. Pauses the agent, recording the acting user. A no-op if the agent is already paused: returns changed=false with the current state rather than clobbering the original pause reason/trigger.

changed.description: False when the agent was already paused.

post.description: Owner-only. Resumes the agent. A no-op if the agent is not currently paused: returns changed=false with the current state.

changed.description: False when the agent was not paused.

post.description: Restarts the agent's session. Restart operations are serialized per-server to prevent concurrent pause/resume/restart cycles from interfering through shared tmux/config state.

Zeroes the agent's tracked restart count. Returns minStatusSeq so the dashboard can drop any in-flight status snapshot built before the reset, preventing the counter from flickering back to its stale value.

minStatusSeq.description: Status snapshots with a lower sequence number predate this reset and should be discarded by the client.

post.description: Sets and persists the agent's backend override, claims operator ownership of the field, and restarts the agent's session so the new backend takes effect immediately.

post.summary: Pin an agent's model or CLI backend
post.description: Pins the given dimension ('cli' or 'model') to a value, claiming operator ownership so the pin survives the pack re-apply that runs on every restart. If the request body omits value, the agent's current effective value for that dimension is used.

value.description: Value to pin; if omitted, the agent's current value for the dimension is used.

400.description: Invalid dimension, agent not found, or Pin call failed

post.summary: Unpin an agent's model or CLI backend
post.description: Removes an existing pin on the given dimension ('cli' or 'model').

400.description: Invalid dimension or Unpin call failed

get.description: Read-only; any authenticated role. Returns whether the fleet breaker is engaged and which agents it is currently holding paused.

post.description: Owner-only. Pauses every running, non-on-demand agent fleet-wide and records exactly that set so release only resumes agents the breaker itself paused. Already-paused and on-demand agents are left untouched. Persisted so an engaged breaker survives a crash.
Owner-only. Resumes only the agents the breaker paused and still owns (unchanged PausedTrigger). On-demand, pre-existing, and operator-re-paused agents are never resumed.

get.description: Returns every agent's bead list, keyed by agent name. Same handler as GET /api/beads/{agent} with the path parameter omitted.

schema.description: Map of agent name to that agent's bead list (shape defined by the beads package's List(); left untyped here as a documentation gap).

get.description: Returns the given agent's bead list.

200.description: Beads for the agent, keyed by agent name

schema.description: Single-key map of agent name to that agent's bead list (shape defined by the beads package's List(); left untyped here as a documentation gap).

404.description: No bead store for this agent

post.summary: Create a bead for an agent
post.description: Owner-only. Creates an advisory (or typed) bead in the given agent's bead store.

400.description: Invalid body, missing/too-long title, or other validation failure

404.description: No bead store for this agent

post.description: Owner-only. Closes all beads across every agent's bead store, recording the given (or default) reason.

reason.description: Defaults to 'manual reset via API' if omitted.

closed.description: Count of beads closed per agent.

post.description: Owner-only. Closes all beads in the given agent's bead store, recording the given (or default) reason.

reason.description: Defaults to 'manual reset via API' if omitted.

404.description: No bead store for this agent

put.description: Owner-only. Merges any of the listed fields present in the body into the agent's config (fields absent from the body are left untouched). Setting model or cliPinValue claims operator ownership of that field and — after saving — applies it live and restarts the agent. promptSource/definitionSource are nested {owner,repo,path,ref[,url]} objects; passing null clears the field, and setting promptSource re-bakes the kick template. Values are validated (mode enum, explain_mode, caveman_mode, backend availability) before being persisted.

schema.description: All fields optional; only keys present are applied.

model.description: Claims operator ownership and is applied live.

cliPinValue.description: Backend id; claims operator ownership and is applied live.

400.description: Invalid body, invalid mode/explain_mode/caveman_mode/backend, prompt source rejected, or definition source repo not allowlisted

put.summary: Update an agent's per-mode governor cadences
put.description: Owner-only. Body is a map of governor mode name to a cadence value, which may be a number of seconds (<=0 means 'pause'), an interval string, or a schedule object. Unknown mode names are silently skipped; invalid cadence values return 400.

schema.description: Map of governor mode name to a cadence (seconds as a number, an interval string, or a schedule object).

400.description: Invalid body or invalid cadence value for a mode

put.description: Owner-only. Sets backend and/or model (either may be omitted/empty to leave unchanged), claiming operator ownership of whichever field is set so a pack re-apply cannot revert it. Does not restart the agent itself; syncs the change into the live process config.
Owner-only. Stores a map of pipeline-step name to enabled/disabled boolean in-memory (not persisted to hive.yaml); read by the dashboard's pipeline view.

schema.description: Map of pipeline step name to boolean enabled/disabled.

put.description: Owner-only. Stores a map of hook-category name to an arbitrary list of hook entries in-memory (not persisted to hive.yaml).

schema.description: Map of hook category name to an array of hook entries (entry shape is caller-defined/opaque).

put.description: Owner-only. Replaces the agent's restrictions.conf file (under /data/agents/{name}/) with the given pattern/reason pairs, one per line.

put.summary: Update an agent's displayed stats config
put.description: Owner-only. Writes the given stats array to a stats.json file under /data/agents/{name}/ (shape of each stats entry is caller-defined/opaque).

get.summary: Export an agent as a portable definition
get.description: Builds a portable AgentDefinition YAML document for the agent (including its raw kick template and governor cadences). Responds as JSON {name, yaml} by default; if the Accept header contains text/yaml or application/yaml, responds with the raw YAML as a downloadable attachment instead.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: Set to text/yaml or application/yaml to receive the raw YAML file instead of JSON.

put.description: Owner-only. Replaces the agent's channels list (shape defined by config.ChannelConfig).

channels.description: config.ChannelConfig entries; left untyped here as a documentation gap.

put.description: Owner-only. Replaces the agent's tools configuration (shape defined by config.ToolsConfig).

schema.description: config.ToolsConfig; left untyped here as a documentation gap.

put.description: Owner-only. Replaces the agent's connections list (shape defined by config.ConnectionConfig; auth secrets are masked when the list is read back).

connections.description: config.ConnectionConfig entries; left untyped here as a documentation gap.

get.description: Returns every defined ACMM maturity-level pack with its agent roster and governor settings, flagging which level is currently active.

post.summary: Apply an ACMM pack at a level
post.description: Owner-only. Force-applies the named ACMM level's pack: creates/updates/pauses/resumes agents to match the pack roster, and forces the governor's cadences to the pack's cadences even if a level switch adds no new agent.

governor_changes.description: Before/after governor eval interval and cadence changes, when any occurred.

tombstoned.description: Pack agents the operator previously deleted and were therefore NOT re-created.

put.description: Owner-only. Sets the hive's ACMM maturity level (1-6), clears per-agent mode overrides so pack modes re-apply cleanly, force-applies that level's pack to reconcile the agent roster and governor cadences/thresholds, and pauses/resumes agents to match the new level's roster. If pack reconciliation fails after the level is already persisted, returns 500 so the operator sees the drift.

400.description: Invalid body or level out of range 1-6

500.description: Roster reconciliation failed after the level was already persisted

put.description: Updates the governor token budget (total tokens per period, period length, critical-percent alert threshold). Pointer-typed fields: an absent field keeps its stored value; validation runs against the effective post-update values. Requires owner role.

400.description: Validation error on the effective budget values

put.description: Updates ioscan, OTel/tracing exporter, retro analysis, mint issuer/enabled, and plan-from-label settings. Every field is pointer-typed; absent fields are unchanged. The mint signing key path is never accepted or returned here. Requires owner role.

400.description: Invalid OTel endpoint or out-of-range sample ratio

put.description: Updates log rotation (max size, max age, max backups, compression) and log level. Requires owner role.

Updates ntfy server/topic and the Discord webhook. A value beginning with the masked-secret bullet character is treated as "unchanged" (the UI echoes masked values back), not a real update. Requires owner role.

Sets the per-mode kick thresholds (e.g. quiet/busy/surge) as a flat map of mode name to integer threshold. Editing any threshold clears threshold-scaling's base-value source for ALL modes, so a hand-tuned value is never subsequently multiplied by repo count. Triggers immediate governor re-evaluation. Requires owner role.

schema.description: Map of mode name (e.g. "quiet", "busy", "surge") to threshold value

put.description: Updates the trajectory-drift review lane: enabled, eval interval, reviewer model/endpoint, transcript line count, and on-divergence action (pause/alert). Takes effect on the next hive restart. Clears the legacy "not configured" system alert. Requires owner role.

Updates the watchdog mode (off/observe/heal), probe interval, crash-loop restart threshold, healthy-reset window, and auth-probe toggle. Setting mode clears the legacy Enabled flag so mode becomes the single source of truth. Requires owner role.

get.description: Returns the advisory digest configuration (max findings, staleness window, autoclose, target). Requires owner role.

put.description: Updates the advisory digest configuration. Every field is optional/pointer-typed; an absent field leaves the stored value unchanged. Requires owner role.

200.description: Updated advisory config (same shape as GET)

400.description: Validation error (out-of-range value, missing linear_issue for linear target)

delete.description: Deletes an agent from the roster and records a deletion tombstone so an ACMM pack apply or config reload will not re-create it. Removes any per-agent overlay file. Requires owner role.

packLevels.description: ACMM pack levels that define this agent, if any

post.description: Creates a new agent with the given backend and model, enabled by default. Lifts any deletion tombstone for the same name. Requires owner role.

name.description: Alphanumeric, hyphens and underscores only; max 64 chars

put.description: Sets the hive-wide toggle for appending a visible "— hive: …" trailer to hive-created PRs and issues. Does not affect the audit log, which always records the invocation. Requires owner role.

delete.description: Removes the self-service backup encryption key file(s) from the PVC and clears governor.backup.key_file/key_name. An env-provided HIVE_BACKUP_KEY, if configured, remains as fallback. Requires owner role.

configured.description: True if an env-fallback key still resolves

get.description: Reports whether a backup encryption key is configured and usable, and its safe source label — never the key value itself. Requires owner role.

usable.description: False if the configured key is truncated/non-hex

put.description: Stores a 64-character hex AES-256 backup encryption key VALUE to an owner-only PVC file; only the resulting file path is recorded in hive.yaml. The key value is never returned, logged, or written to hive.yaml. Requires owner role.

delete.description: Removes the stored bob API key file and drops the api_key_file pointer from hive.yaml (only if it names the file just removed). Reports whether an admin-managed key source still resolves. Requires owner role.

get.description: Reports whether a bob API key is configured and its safe source label — never the key value.

put.description: Stores a bob API key VALUE to an owner-only PVC file (and best-effort into the hive-secrets Secret); hive.yaml records only the file path. Relaunches any bob agents that were parked awaiting a key. Requires owner role.

relaunched.description: Count of parked bob agents relaunched by this save

400.description: Missing/empty/too-long key, or key contains interior whitespace

post.description: Live-validates a bob API key. A non-empty apiKey in the body tests that value directly (never persisted, logged, or echoed); an empty/absent body tests the currently saved key. Always returns HTTP 200 with the verdict in the body.

apiKey.description: Optional; omit to test the saved key

400.description: Key too long or malformed request body

post.description: Opens a fresh budget-tracking window immediately: spend re-anchors to zero and once-per-window alerts rearm. Budgeting stays enabled. Requires owner role.

minStatusSeq.description: Sequence floor so the dashboard discards pre-reset status snapshots

delete.description: Removes a named model gateway. Refuses with 409 if any agent currently references it as its backend, listing the offending agents. Requires owner role.

409.description: Gateway in use by one or more agents

get.description: Returns the effective list of configured model gateways (OpenRouter, LiteLLM, vLLM, llm-d, watsonx, custom), including a legacy litellm: block synthesized as a gateway if present. Never returns key values, only presence and a masked hint.

put.summary: Create or replace a model gateway
put.description: Upserts a gateway by name. An api_key VALUE, if sent, is written to a per-gateway secret file (never inlined into hive.yaml) and the gateway's legacy litellm: section is kept in sync if it points at the same endpoint. Runs a live save-time probe when a key is submitted. Requires owner role.

endpoint.description: Absolute http(s) URL; may be omitted for watsonx if region is set

api_key.description: Key VALUE; stored to a secret file, never echoed

key_name.description: Optional human label for the key

200.description: Gateway saved, with a live connectivity probe result

gateway.description: Same shape as one item of GET /gateways

400.description: Invalid name/kind/endpoint, or field looks like a pasted key value

post.summary: Discover models for an arbitrary gateway endpoint
post.description: Probes a caller-supplied endpoint's /v1/models so the add/edit gateway form's model dropdown can populate before saving. The key is used transiently only. Falls back to a stored gateway's key ONLY when the caller-supplied endpoint matches that gateway's own persisted endpoint (SSRF/exfiltration guard). Blocks private/loopback/link-local resolution targets. Requires owner role.

name.description: Existing gateway name to fall back to for kind/key/project_id

200.description: Discovery result (always HTTP 200; ok:false on failure)

fallback.description: True when the static watsonx Granite list was used

400.description: Missing/invalid endpoint, or endpoint resolves to a private/loopback address

post.description: Runs a live /v1/models probe against a named gateway's persisted endpoint and resolved key.

get.description: Returns the governor eval interval, attribution-trailer resolved state, and explain-mode configured/effective/source values. Requires owner role.

put.description: Updates the governor eval interval, attribution-trailer toggle, and hive-wide explain-mode default. Fields are pointer-typed; absent fields are left unchanged. An explicit empty explain_mode clears the hive default. Requires owner role.
Updates healthcheck interval, restart cooldown, and the model-lock toggle. Requires owner role.
Updates hub connectivity and Contribute-mode filters (title/author/label modes, allow/deny lists, cooldown, delegatable roles, disabled repos/tiers, tier limits). Requires owner role.

tier_limits.description: Map of tier name to rate limit object

get.description: Returns the discovery-auth configuration for the self-hosted vllm and llm-d backends. References only (header name, env var name, file path, endpoint override) — never a key value. Requires owner role.

put.description: Updates the vllm and/or llm-d discovery-auth sections. Each section is optional; within it, absent fields are unchanged. Rejects an env/file field that looks like a pasted key value, and confines api_key_file to the managed secrets dirs. Requires owner role.

200.description: Updated (same shape as GET, plus ok/status)

400.description: Field looks like a key value, or api_key_file outside managed secrets dirs, or invalid endpoint

put.summary: Update exempt and required issue labels
put.description: Updates the exempt-labels list (governor.labels) and/or the require-labels gate (project.issue_filter.require_labels). Pointer-typed fields: an absent key leaves that list unchanged. Permanent hold/exempt labels cannot be removed via the exempt list. Requires owner role.

post.description: Runs a live /v1/models probe against the currently effective LiteLLM endpoint and key. Never falls back to the static model alias list.

put.description: Updates governor.litellm (legacy single-gateway config). An apiKey VALUE, if sent, is stored via a PVC file (and best-effort into the hive-secrets Secret); hive.yaml records only the file path. Runs a live save-time probe and re-applies inference routes to running agents. Requires owner role.

apiKey.description: Key VALUE; stored to a file, never echoed

200.description: Updated, with a live connectivity probe result

400.description: Field looks like a key value, api_key_file outside managed secrets dirs, or config validation failure

get.description: Returns the operator-selected open-source/kube-native/commercial observability platforms, backend references, whether the telemetry/operations agents are enabled, the supported platform catalog, and detected suggestions from the telemetry agent's advisory findings. Requires owner role.

references.description: Map of platform name to {endpoint_env, credential_secret}

supported.description: Map of family to allowed platform slugs

detected.description: Map of family to platform slugs suggested from telemetry advisory text; may be null

put.description: Updates the selected observability platforms and backend references, and toggles the telemetry/operations agent cadences accordingly. Enabling telemetry or operations requires at least one platform already selected. Requires owner role.

references.description: Map of platform name to {endpoint_env, credential_secret}; values must be env-var names / secret-name/key refs, never literals

400.description: Unsupported platform, invalid reference format, or enabling with no platform selected

get.description: Returns the stall-replan configuration (enabled, interval, stall threshold, max replans) with defaults resolved. Requires owner role.

put.description: Updates the stall-replan configuration. Fields are pointer-typed; absent fields are unchanged. Requires owner role.

put.summary: Update monitored repos and default repo
put.description: Updates the list of monitored repos and/or the primary (default) repo. Enforces single-host-per-spoke (all repos must be on the hive's own GitHub host) and requires exactly one default repo among the monitored set. Triggers re-enumeration on success. Requires owner role.

repos.description: org/repo, bare repo name, or full URL

400.description: Empty repo list, invalid repo name, cross-host repo, or no default repo set

post.summary: Check GitHub App access to a repo
post.description: Verifies the hive's GitHub App can access a repo's org before it is added, probing at org install granularity. Returns an install/authorize URL when access is missing. A hive with no App key configured (advisory-only) always reports no-app.

repo.description: org/repo, bare repo name, or full URL

400.description: Missing repo, cannot determine org, or repo on a different GitHub host

put.description: Updates ioscan enable/fail-mode/canaries, intent-alignment enforcement, PR review-gate settings, and the agent sandbox toggle. Requires owner role.

Updates the governor eval interval, GitHub/CLI rate-limit detection regex patterns, login-prompt patterns, and TTL/pullback timings used by rate-limit sensing. Each regex is compiled and rejected if invalid. Requires owner role.

get.description: Returns the configured threshold-scaling curve (linear/sqrt/none) with its default applied. Requires owner role.

put.description: Sets how the default mode thresholds scale with the hive's repo count. Triggers immediate governor re-evaluation. Requires owner role.

get.description: Returns the configured work source (github, github_projects, linear, or jira) and its per-source settings. Linear's api_key is reported only as api_key_set (never the value). Requires owner role.

put.description: Updates the work source type and/or its per-source settings (github_projects, linear, jira). List-valued fields (hold_labels, teams, project_keys, states) replace the stored list when present. Validates Linear team/session-agent/assigned-only settings before applying. Requires owner role.

400.description: Invalid type, invalid Linear team, unknown session_agent, or assigned_only without a connected Linear agent

get.description: Returns every fact aggregated across all configured layers, vaults, and connected git sources. Returns `{"enabled": false, "facts": []}` if the knowledge base is not enabled.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter facts by fact type (e.g. pattern, gotcha, decision)

200.description: All facts, or a disabled placeholder

get.description: Returns the current configuration and running state of the background bead synthesizer, which mines closed beads into knowledge facts.

put.summary: Enable or disable the bead synthesizer
put.description: Starts or stops the background bead synthesizer and persists the setting. Requires owner role.

put.summary: Enable or disable the knowledge base
put.description: Enables or disables the whole knowledge subsystem, (re)constructing the knowledge API from configured layers when turning on, and starting/stopping the bead synthesizer accordingly. Persists the setting. Requires owner role.

get.description: Returns user-writable channels (vaults) that facts can be imported into. The reserved automation vault used by the bead synthesizer is excluded. Returns `[]` if the knowledge base is not enabled.

post.description: Creates a new local channel (vault) that facts can subsequently be imported into.

400.description: Invalid request body, or channel creation failed

get.description: Proxies a library search to the Context7 documentation service, for selecting a library to import as a document source.
Returns metadata for all documents (PDFs, URLs, files, or Context7 libraries) imported into the knowledge base.

post.description: Imports a PDF, URL, local file, or Context7 library as a knowledge document, extracting facts from its content. Exactly one of url, file_path, or context7_id must be given. A URL must use http/https and must not resolve to a private/internal address.

400.description: Invalid body, missing name/source, or disallowed URL

get.description: Returns metadata for a single imported document by slug.

delete.description: Deletes an imported document and its associated facts by slug.

post.description: Re-fetches and re-parses an already-imported document, refreshing its extracted facts.

get.description: Renders all facts across layers/vaults/git sources as a single grouped markdown document, sorted stably by slug so unchanged content re-exports byte-for-byte identically. Response includes an ETag header computed over the rendered body.

200.description: Markdown export of the knowledge base

get.description: Returns the recorded time series of total knowledge fact counts, sampled roughly every 5 minutes (up to ~30 days retained), for the dashboard's fact sparkline.
Returns all git repositories (or subdirectories) connected as knowledge sources. Returns `[]` if the knowledge base is not enabled.

post.description: Clones (or re-uses) a git repository and indexes it (or a subpath within it) as a knowledge source, persisting the connection to config. Requires owner role. The URL is validated against SSRF (private/internal targets rejected); name must not contain path separators or '..'; branch/subpath must not start with '-' and subpath must not contain '..'.

400.description: Invalid body, missing name/url, disallowed URL, or invalid name/branch/subpath

delete.description: Removes a connected git source identified by URL (and optional subpath) and drops it from config. Requires owner role.

get.description: Returns a graph of facts and their relationships (nodes and edges), optionally rooted at a given fact slug and limited to a traversal depth. Returns empty nodes/edges if knowledge or the graph store is unavailable.

parameters.name: root
parameters.description: Slug of the fact to root the graph traversal at; omit for the full graph

get.description: Checks each configured wiki layer's reachability and returns its status. Returns `{"enabled": false}` if the knowledge base is not configured.
Searches across all layers and vaults by free-text query or tag. Either `q` or `tag` is required. Returns `{"results": []}` if the knowledge base is not enabled.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search query (required if tag is omitted)

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Filter by exact tag match, case-insensitive (required if q is omitted)

get.description: Returns aggregate stats across all layers, vaults, and git sources (fact counts by type/status, staleness, orphan counts). Also updates the fact-count and estimated-cost history sparklines as a side effect (throttled to ~5-min intervals). Returns `{"enabled": false}` if the knowledge base is not enabled.
Returns user-added remote wiki endpoint subscriptions. Returns `[]` if the knowledge base is not enabled.

post.description: Adds a remote wiki endpoint as a subscribed layer source. URL must use http/https and must not point to a private/internal address.

400.description: Invalid body, missing url, disallowed scheme, or private/internal URL

delete.description: Removes a previously added wiki subscription by URL.

get.description: Returns all connected file-based (Obsidian or plain markdown directory) vaults. Returns `[]` if the knowledge base is not enabled.

post.description: Indexes a directory tree as a knowledge vault. Requires owner role, since it makes the entire directory's contents queryable via search. Path must be absolute, must not contain '..', and must not be under a restricted system prefix (/etc, /proc, /sys, /run, /var/run, /dev, /root, /boot).

name.description: Defaults to the path's base name if omitted

400.description: Invalid body, missing path, relative/traversal path, restricted path, or connect failed

delete.description: Removes a connected vault by its root path.

400.description: Invalid body, missing path, relative, or traversal path

post.description: Re-scans a connected vault's directory tree to refresh its indexed facts.

400.description: Invalid body, missing path, relative, or traversal path

get.description: Returns all facts indexed from a single connected vault by name. Returns `[]` if the knowledge base is not enabled or the vault has no facts.

Returns facts for a single layer (personal, project, org, community), or for a git source when `{layer}` is prefixed `git_source:<name>`. Returns `{"enabled": false, "facts": []}` if the knowledge base is not enabled, or an empty facts array if the named git source is unknown.

parameters.name: layer
parameters.description: Layer name (personal, project, org, community) or "git_source:<name>"

get.description: Returns one fact by slug. Note the handler resolves the fact by slug alone (via ReadFact, which also checks vaults) — the `{layer}` path segment identifies which layer/collection UI context the request came from but is not otherwise used to scope the lookup.

404.description: Knowledge not enabled, or fact not found

put.description: Updates an existing fact's fields in the given layer.

500.description: Update failed (e.g. layer has no configured endpoint)

delete.description: Deletes a fact by slug from the given layer.

500.description: Delete failed (e.g. layer has no configured endpoint)

post.description: Removes facts that reference deleted documents, returning the number of facts removed.

Creates a new fact directly (as opposed to extracting one from a PR/import). Title and body are required; layer defaults to "project", type defaults to "pattern", confidence defaults to 0.7 if not positive.

500.description: Creation failed (e.g. layer has no configured endpoint)

post.description: Bulk-imports facts by parsing raw content (markdown or other supported format) into a layer, returning the count of facts imported.

Webhook target for the Obsidian Post Webhook plugin: upserts a note (with flattened frontmatter) as a knowledge fact, creating or updating it by filename-derived slug. Filename must not contain path traversal sequences.

content.description: Defaults to the frontmatter title, or "(no body)", if empty

frontmatter.description: Arbitrary frontmatter fields (title, type, layer, confidence, tags, etc.); the plugin's top-level extra fields are folded in here too

400.description: Invalid body, missing filename, or path traversal in filename

post.description: Copies a fact from a lower-precedence layer to a higher-precedence one (e.g. project to org) with provenance metadata. If the source fact lives only in a vault (not a wiki layer), falls back to syncing it into the target layer via the Obsidian sync path. slug, from_layer, and to_layer are required; promoter defaults to "dashboard".

400.description: Invalid body, missing required fields, or promotion failed with no vault fallback available

delete.summary: Remove a hive from the federation registry
delete.description: Unregisters a peer hive from the discovery list. Destructive administrative action on shared state — requires the HIVE_DASHBOARD_TOKEN dashboard auth AND the owner role (requireOwnerRole); any other role gets 403. The hive can re-register itself later via POST /api/hives/register.

get.description: Returns the recent contributor activity feed held by the contribute hub. Public (no auth) — lives under the /api/contribute prefix which isPublicPath treats as public, read-only, no side effects. Returns an empty activity list if the contribute hub is not initialized.

activity.description: Recent ActivityEntry records (untyped here — see contribute_sse.go ActivityEntry for the full shape)

get.summary: Get the caller's own dossier fields
get.description: Returns the caller's own self-service dossier fields (archetype, specializations, testimony, equipped title, Credly name, emblem seed). Identity is resolved server-side (session / X-Hive-User header / Authorization: Bearer <gh-token>) via resolveContributeCaller — never from the request — so a caller only ever sees their own dossier. Public path, but requires the caller to be identifiable and already have a contributor profile.

401.description: Not signed in (identity could not be resolved)

403.description: No contributor profile exists yet for the caller

post.summary: Update the caller's own dossier fields
post.description: Partially updates the caller's self-service dossier fields (archetype, specializations, testimony, equipped title, Credly name, emblem seed). Every field is a pointer: an absent field leaves the stored value untouched, an explicit empty value clears it. All values are sanitized/bounded server-side (never rejected for length — truncated instead). Identity resolved server-side via resolveContributeCaller, never from the body. Same handler function as GET /api/contribute/dossier, dispatching on HTTP method.

401.description: Not signed in (identity could not be resolved)

403.description: No contributor profile exists yet for the caller

get.description: Server-Sent Events stream (Content-Type: text/event-stream), NOT a single JSON response. Public, read-only — anonymous browsers may subscribe. On connect it sends one 'hello' frame carrying a bounded replay of recent activity plus a ready-work queue snapshot (and, when the convergence-diagnostics shadow-mode toggle is on, additive 'withheld'/'admission_coverage' fields), then forwards each subsequent activity event as an 'activity' frame. An idle connection receives a ': ping' comment roughly every 25s to keep intermediaries from timing out the stream. Each event line is JSON-encoded per the sseEvent shape ({type, activity?, replay?, queue?, withheld?, admission_coverage?}).

200.description: text/event-stream of sseEvent frames (hello, then activity, with periodic heartbeat comments)

500.description: Streaming unsupported by the response writer

503.description: Event stream unavailable (contribute hub not initialized)

get.description: Read-only snapshot for the Management & Operations tab: connected clankers, in-flight work items, the hub's configured admission policy, plus cooldown/in-flight/held issue counts. Public, GET only, no side effects.

policy.description: ContributeAdmissionPolicy — the configured merge/automation posture and admission filters

get.summary: Get the caller's own label interests
get.description: Returns the caller's own opt-in list of GitHub labels used to prioritise matching issues for them. Self-service — identity resolved server-side via resolveContributeCaller, never from the request; a caller only ever reads their own interests.

401.description: Not signed in (identity could not be resolved)

403.description: No contributor profile exists yet for the caller

put.summary: Replace the caller's own label interests
put.description: Replaces the caller's opt-in list of GitHub labels with the submitted set. Entries are trimmed, lower-cased, de-duplicated, capped at 64 entries of up to 128 characters each; a hostile payload is cleaned rather than rejected. Self-service — identity resolved server-side via resolveContributeCaller, never from the body — so a caller only ever writes their own interests. Deliberately does NOT require write-tier (any registered contributor may set this preference).

401.description: Not signed in (identity could not be resolved)

403.description: No contributor profile exists yet for the caller

get.summary: Per-tier rate limits and the caller's own usage
get.description: Returns the hive's configured per-tier managed-queue rate limits (from Config.Hub.TierLimits), plus a 'you' block with the caller's own current hour/day usage when their identity can be resolved server-side (session / X-Hive-User header). Public, GET only. An anonymous caller gets the tier table with no 'you' block.

200.description: Tier limits and optional caller usage

you.description: Present only when the caller's identity is resolvable

get.description: Returns up to 168 hourly buckets (7 days) of persisted series feeding the Operations/Leaderboard sparklines: queue depth, task completions, fleet size, and per-contributor completions. Public, GET only, no side effects — only counts and already-public github_usernames, no tokens or PII.

per_user_done.description: Map of github_username -> array of per-hour completion counts

get.description: Returns a small, curated set of admissible issues not already at the front of the ready queue, ranked by a light recency heat proxy. Public, GET only, read-only discovery list.

Returns the admissible issues waiting to be picked off (the same set selectTask offers from), used both as a JSON fallback for browsers without EventSource and as the same payload the SSE 'hello' frame carries. Public, GET only. When the caller's identity is resolvable and they have declared label interests, the response is personalised (matching issues floated to the front, plus an echoed 'interests' field) without filtering anything out for other viewers.

withheld.description: Present only when the convergence-diagnostics shadow-mode toggle is enabled

admission_coverage.description: Present only when the convergence-diagnostics shadow-mode toggle is enabled

interests.description: Present only when the caller's identity is resolvable

get.description: Returns a live-derived, Warp-style grouping of contribute issues into a lifecycle ladder (Triaging -> Ready to implement -> Implementing -> Reviewing -> Closed), computed per request from the ready queue, fleet snapshot, and PR-issue link resolver. No persistent lifecycle store. Public, GET only, read-only.
Returns the ranked contributor leaderboard (task counts, trust tier) plus agent leaderboard entries. Public, GET only, read-only.

agents.description: Agent leaderboard entries, same LeaderboardEntry shape with is_agent=true

get.description: Returns one contributor's central profile aggregated from the contributor store, the ranked leaderboard, and the federation registry: identity, trust tier, task stats, rank, milestones, related hives, collaborators, and self-service dossier fields. Public, GET only, read-only — every field here is already visible elsewhere on the public leaderboard/dossier surfaces. Never errors for an unknown username; instead returns found:false.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: GitHub username (alphanumerics and hyphens, max 39 chars)

200.description: Contributor profile (found:false with only github_username set when no profile exists)

last_active.description: Included only when within the last 14 days

get.description: Returns the trimmed public Credly badges for one contributor, mirrored through a 6h server-side cache (5min negative cache on fetch failure). Public, GET only, read-only — Credly badges are already public at credly.com. A contributor with no linked Credly name (or a failed fetch) returns an empty, unlinked response.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: GitHub username (alphanumerics and hyphens, max 39 chars)

get.description: Fetches, sanitizes, and returns a caller-supplied stylesheet (?src=... — a raw.githubusercontent.com or same-origin/data-URL-excluded source, scope forced to "leaderboard") for the leaderboard's optional custom-style feature. Public, GET only. Response is normally raw CSS (text/css) with a Cache-Control of 5 minutes and an X-Hive-Style-Dropped header when unsafe rules were stripped; pass ?report=1 to get a JSON diagnostic report instead of raw CSS. Returns 404 if the source cannot be found, 422 on any other validation/sanitization failure.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: The style source identifier/URL to fetch and sanitize

parameters.name: report
parameters.description: Set to "1" to receive a JSON sanitize report instead of raw CSS

200.description: Sanitized CSS (text/css) or, with ?report=1, a JSON report

post.summary: Mint a trusted, attributed invite link
post.description: Mints a shareable /contribute onboarding link carrying a signed invite token that attributes whoever registers via it to the caller. Requires the caller be signed in AND hold trusted/merger/advisor trust tier (checked in-handler, since /api/contribute is exempt from the dashboard's read-only role middleware) — an anonymous or insufficiently-trusted caller gets 401/403. The invite never elevates the invitee's tier; they still join as newcomer.

401.description: Sign in with GitHub to invite someone

403.description: No contributor profile, or trust tier below trusted/merger/advisor

post.summary: Hold or resume one queue issue
post.description: Toggles the operator hold on one ready-work issue, parking it out of the offer pool until resumed (distinct from the self-clearing time-based cooldown). Owner/read-write only, enforced in-handler via requireContributorWrite (read/anonymous caller gets 403). Persists into Config.Hub.ContributeQueueHold via refreshAndPersist.

reason.description: Optional short note explaining why the issue is parked; ignored when held=false

400.description: Invalid request body or invalid/malformed issue key, or hold set at capacity

post.description: Bulk companion to POST /api/contribute/queue/hold: drops the entire operator hold set (and its reason map) in one call. Same owner/read-write gate (requireContributorWrite) and persistence path. Idempotent.

cleared.description: Number of held issues that were cleared

post.description: Self-service, unauthenticated registration: creates a new contributor profile for the given GitHub username and returns a one-time plaintext registration token (never recoverable — only its hash is stored). If the username is already registered, returns its contributor_id and a message pointing to POST /api/contribute/reissue-token instead of reissuing a token here (SECURITY: reissuing here would let anyone take over a known username's token). An optional invite token attributes (but never elevates) the new contributor to their inviter.

force.description: Legacy flag, now ignored for security reasons

registration_token.description: Present only on first registration — save it, it cannot be recovered

post.description: Lets a contributor recover access by proving ownership of their GitHub identity via Authorization: Bearer <github-personal-access-token>. Invalidates the previous token and returns a new one.

post.summary: Yank a contributor's in-flight task and reassign
post.description: Operator action: releases a clanker's current in-flight task (with the same release+cooldown machinery as automatic disconnect/abandon handling) and immediately attempts to hand it its next-priority item so it keeps working. Requires the HIVE_DASHBOARD_TOKEN dashboard auth AND owner/read-write role, enforced in-handler via requireContributorWrite (read/anonymous caller gets 403). An optional reason may be supplied via query param or JSON body.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Optional operator reason (alternatively supplied in the JSON body)

404.description: Contributor not found, or has no in-flight task to yank

post.description: Sets the contributor's trust tier to "revoked" (a terminal, admin-authoritative state via a CAS write) and disconnects any live WebSocket sessions they hold. Requires the HIVE_DASHBOARD_TOKEN dashboard auth AND the owner role (requireOwnerRole); any other role gets 403.

post.summary: Get onboarding next-steps for a new hive
post.description: Validates the given project_name/org/repos and returns a fixed list of manual next-step instructions for installing the Hive GitHub App and registering the hive. Does not create or persist anything itself.

post.summary: Register or update a hive in the federation registry
post.description: Registers a new peer hive (or updates hub_url/dashboard_url if a hive with the same derived ID already exists). hub_url and dashboard_url must use http(s)/ws(s) scheme and must not resolve to a private/internal address (SSRF guard).

updated.description: True when an existing entry with the same ID was updated instead of created

400.description: Missing required fields, invalid URL scheme, or a URL targets a private/internal address

post.description: Updates a registered hive's active_contributors, active_contributor_names, active_agents, and actionable_items counts, and bumps last_heartbeat to now. All fields are optional in the body and individually bounds-checked/sanitized; an invalid field is simply left unchanged rather than rejecting the whole request.

put.summary: Set the operator priority override for the ready queue
put.description: Persists an ordered list of "owner/repo#number" keys as the operator's priority override for the ready-work queue's offer order. Owner/read-write only, enforced in-handler via requireContributorWrite (read/anonymous caller gets 403). Malformed or duplicate keys are dropped rather than rejected. The override only changes offer priority — it is applied AFTER admission/cooldown/disabled/in-flight exclusions, so a pinned-but-filtered issue is never resurrected. Persists into Config.Hub.ContributeQueueOrder via refreshAndPersist.

400.description: Invalid request body, or too many queue-order keys

put.description: Assigns (or clears, with agent_role="none") a contributor's assigned agent role. Owner-only, enforced in-handler via requireOwnerRole (issue #3011 — previously under-gated to read-write). The requested role must be on the server-side assignable allowlist; a role requiring an operator grant (roleClaimNeedsGrant) is refused unless the contributor already holds that grant (grants are issued separately via PUT .../agent-role-grants and are never auto-granted here).

role.description: Fallback field name if agent_role is empty

400.description: Invalid request body, role not assignable, role claim disallowed, or role requires an ungranted operator grant

put.summary: Set a contributor's grantable agent-role delegations
put.description: Sets the set of privileged agent roles the contributor has been operator-granted (a prerequisite for later being assigned one of those roles via PUT .../agent-role). Owner-only, enforced in-handler via requireOwnerRole. Each submitted role must be on the server-side grantable allowlist or the whole request is rejected with 400.

400.description: Invalid request body, or a submitted role is not a grantable delegated privileged role

put.description: Sets the contributor's trust tier directly (admin override — able to change a terminal "revoked" tier, via a CAS write that wins against any concurrent stale WebSocket save). Owner-only, enforced in-handler via requireOwnerRole. If the new tier is "revoked", any live WebSocket sessions the contributor holds are disconnected.

400.description: Invalid request body or invalid tier

delete.description: Removes an accumulated principle by id from the Nous knowledge base. Requires owner role.

get.description: Returns the raw Nous config map (sections such as goals, repos, output, fast_fail, schedule, controllables, principles). Shape is dynamic/section-keyed and not owner-gated for reads.

post.description: Marks the current experiment as aborted. Requires owner role.
Approves the current Nous proposal/experiment. Requires owner role.

post.summary: Respond to a Nous gate prompt
post.description: Records a free-form response to the currently pending Nous gate (approval checkpoint). Requires owner role. Request body is stored verbatim as the gate response.

schema.description: Arbitrary JSON object; stored as-is as the gate response.

put.description: Replaces the 'controllables' section of the Nous config with the request body. Requires owner role. Body shape is caller-defined (stored as an opaque JSON value under this section).
Replaces the 'fast_fail' section of the Nous config with the request body. Requires owner role.
Replaces the 'goals' section of the Nous config with the request body. Requires owner role.
Replaces the 'output' section of the Nous config with the request body. Requires owner role.
Replaces the 'principles' section of the Nous config with the request body. Requires owner role.
Replaces the 'repos' section of the Nous config with the request body. Requires owner role.
Replaces the 'schedule' section of the Nous config with the request body. Requires owner role.
Records a decision (e.g. approve/reject) plus optional reason for the currently pending Nous gate. Requires owner role.
Sets the Nous engine mode (e.g. observe/suggest/auto). Requires owner role.
Sets the Nous engine scope (e.g. governor/repo). Requires owner role.

get.summary: Download the produced scaffold as a zip
get.description: Produces the current inception scaffold and streams it as a zip file attachment (application/zip). No JSON body on success.

404.description: Inception engine not initialized, no scaffold, or no files to download

get.summary: Check whether the inception wiki has files
get.description: Reports whether the inception knowledge wiki currently has any files on disk.
Returns the facts gathered so far during ideation, preferring the knowledge store's ideation facts and falling back to the inception engine's in-memory gathered facts.
Produces the scaffold result from the current inception state (file list/content). Not owner-gated.

scaffold.description: Scaffold result including a Files list; shape not fully enumerated here — see inception.ProduceScaffold.

get.description: Returns the current inception engine state (idea capture / question / structure phase, etc). State shape is dynamic (inception engine internal state struct).

state.description: Inception engine state; null when no session is active.

post.description: Submits a map of question-id to answer text, advancing the inception session. Requires owner role.

400.description: Invalid body or submission rejected by the engine

post.description: Advances the inception session to complete and re-pauses the brainstorm agent (on-demand only afterward). Requires owner role.
Records a batch of ideation facts against the knowledge base. Requires owner role.

post.summary: Import a wiki zip into the inception wiki directory
post.description: Accepts a multipart/form-data upload (field name 'file') of a zip archive (max 10 MiB) and extracts it into the inception wiki directory. Requires owner role.

400.description: Missing file, unreadable upload, or invalid zip

post.description: Sets the list of clarifying questions for the active inception session. Requires owner role.

400.description: Invalid body or rejected by engine

post.description: Resets the inception engine state, clears any open brainstorm/inception beads, and re-pauses the brainstorm agent. Requires owner role.

Starts inception in brownfield mode against an existing repo URL. Optional force=true resets any existing session first (pausing brainstorm and clearing its beads). Kicks the brainstorm agent. Requires owner role.

400.description: Invalid body or scan could not start

post.description: Starts a new inception session from a free-text idea. Optional force=true resets any existing session first (pausing brainstorm and clearing its beads). Kicks the brainstorm agent. Requires owner role.

put.description: Renames the inception knowledge vault (max 80 characters) and persists the name in inception state. Requires owner role.

get.description: Returns the review view of a decomposed epic: the epic plus its children with execution tags and dependency edges. Not owner-gated.

404.description: Epic not found in any bead store

post.summary: Propose a plan from a GitHub issue
post.description: Mints a DRAFT epic from an issue (idempotent) and requests decomposition by kicking the architect agent out-of-band (respecting its pause). Deliberately NOT owner-gated — mints a draft epic whose children are withheld from execution until approved. Rejected with 409 when planning is not allowed at the hive's current ACMM level.

title.description: If empty, the server attempts to resolve repo+number/url against the last enumerated actionable issues.

400.description: Invalid body or missing resolvable issue title

409.description: Planning not allowed at the hive's current ACMM level

post.description: Approves the plan, releasing its children through Ready() for agent execution. Requires owner role.

404.description: Epic not found in any bead store

404.description: Epic not found in any bead store

post.description: Returns an approved (or draft) plan to draft state, re-gating its children. Requires owner role.

404.description: Epic not found in any bead store

get.summary: Check whether a dashboard auth token is configured
get.description: Reports only whether HIVE_DASHBOARD_TOKEN (or the configured dashboard token) is set — never the token value. Returns 404 on direct-route or hub-proxied hives, where the shared token is not exposed to browsers.

404.description: Not available on this hive (direct-route or hub-proxied)

get.summary: Get Claude Code OAuth login status
get.description: Reports whether a Claude access token is currently stored.

get.summary: Land on the dashboard after device-flow login
get.description: Redirects (302) to '/'. The session cookie was already set by the poll endpoint; this never mints a session itself.

post.description: Exchanges an authorization code (or one extracted from a pasted callback URL) plus the server-held PKCE verifier for Claude tokens, persists credentials, and reloads the agent manager's token. Requires owner role.

500.description: Token exchange or credential save failed

Generates PKCE parameters and returns the Claude authorize URL, storing the verifier/state server-side for the subsequent exchange. Requires owner role.
Removes the stored Copilot token and clears it on the agent manager. Requires owner role.
Begins a GitHub device-flow authorization for Copilot CLI and starts a background poller. Requires owner role.

500.description: Failed to build device code request

502.description: Device code request/response from GitHub failed

post.summary: Log out the current GitHub user session
post.description: Deletes only the calling request's session. The persisted GitHub user token on disk is removed only when the logging-out user's session role was owner (or auth is not enforced).

Polls GitHub for the outcome of a device flow started via /api/gh-user-auth/start. On success validates the GitHub identity, enforces the allowlist on direct-route hives, and mints a per-user session cookie.
Starts a GitHub OAuth device flow using the hive's resolved GitHub OAuth client id and stores the flow state server-side.

post.summary: Flag that the GitHub App install link was clicked
post.description: Sets a pending-install flag so the periodic heartbeat/self-heal loop knows an install attempt is underway. Not owner-gated.
Re-auto-discovers the GitHub App installation id and rechecks installation/permissions. Not owner-gated. Returns 501 when recheck is not configured.

get.description: Reports whether Linear credentials are configured, the install/connection state, and tracked agent sessions. Requires owner role.

sessions.description: Tracker snapshot; shape not fully enumerated (linearagent tracker internal).

post.description: Forgets the local install record (does not revoke the grant on Linear's side). Requires owner role.
Starts the Linear actor=app authorize flow and returns the authorize URL plus the redirect_uri this hive will use (must match the Linear app's configured callback URL). Requires owner role.

Public webhook endpoint for Linear AgentSessionEvent payloads. HMAC verification over the raw body and replay-window checks happen inside the receiver. Response shape is delegated to the linearagent receiver.

get.summary: Start an OpenRouter PKCE funding flow
get.description: Generates a PKCE verifier/challenge and single-use state (optionally scoped to a `model` query param) and returns the openrouter.ai authorize URL. Not owner-gated.
Proxies OpenRouter's /v1/key using the stored gateway key. Never returns the key itself. Not owner-gated.
Returns the curated suggested model list plus OpenRouter's best-effort live model catalog. No key required (public endpoint).

get.summary: Render a QR code for an OpenRouter authorize URL
get.description: Renders a same-origin PNG QR code for the `data` query param, which must be an OpenRouter authorize URL (validated by prefix) — used to keep the connect-flow off vendored client JS.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Must start with the OpenRouter authorize URL.

400.description: data must be an OpenRouter authorize URL

get.description: Returns an advisory (read-only, never mutates the applied level) recommendation on whether to stay or raise the ACMM level, derived from live status signals.
Returns the (hourly-cached) ACMM evaluation across levels/criteria/repos, stamped with the current operational level, overall level, and issue-tracker destination.

post.summary: File an issue for a failed ACMM criterion
post.description: Files a gap issue for a failed ACMM criterion on GitHub (default) or, when configured/overridden, on the mapped Linear team. Requires owner role.

tracker.description: Optional per-request override of the configured default.

500.description: Config not loaded / org not configured

get.summary: Check whether self-service backup is available
get.description: Reports whether a backup-encryption key is configured, so the UI can disable the backup menu entry with a real reason. Requires owner role.

source.description: Present when available; safe 'file:<path>' or 'env:<NAME>' label, never the key.

post.summary: Build and download an encrypted spoke backup
post.description: Builds an AES-256-GCM encrypted archive of this spoke's data and streams it as an octet-stream attachment. POST (not GET) so the credential-bearing response cannot be reached via a plain link/img tag. Requires owner role. Bounded by a build timeout.
Records that the authenticated (session or hub-proxy-injected) user dismissed a banner by id. Read-only viewers are rejected.

403.description: Not signed in, or read-only role

get.description: Returns one row per closed budget window (newest first) plus the currently open window from live status. `windows` is always an array, never null.

post.description: Chat is not yet fully implemented; echoes the submitted query back in a stub answer.

get.description: Returns the spoke's device-flow login allowlist (username, role, optional display_name) — read-only; authoritative source is the hub's Manage Access, propagated via heartbeat.

enforced.description: True on a direct-route spoke that gates logins by this list.

get.description: Returns AutoMergeConfig for the Governor Features tab. Requires owner role.

put.description: Updates auto_merge settings; every field is nilable so an absent key leaves that setting untouched. Requires owner role.

get.description: Returns the configured and effective convergence mode, env override state, and captured generation. Requires owner role.

put.description: Updates convergence.mode after validating it against the known set of modes; the change takes effect live at the start of the next eval cycle. Requires owner role.

get.description: Returns longitudinal soak-comparison telemetry: the running commit, effective mode/generation, and recorded per-pass entries (newest first). Requires owner role.

get.summary: Download the raw hive.yaml config file
get.description: Streams the raw config file (hive.yaml, or HIVE_CONFIG path) as an attachment. Carries secrets — strictly owner-gated (an empty role does NOT default to owner here).
Returns the escalation breaker settings (disabled flag, threshold, and its resolved effective value). Requires owner role.

put.description: Updates disabled/threshold; both fields are nilable so an absent key leaves that setting untouched. Requires owner role.

get.description: Read-only inventory of every forge App credential the spoke holds (fingerprints/paths only, never key material) plus the single editable active config and whether it is editable on this spoke.

put.description: Updates app_id/installation_id/key_file, or writes a new private key (to key_file or the default path) and re-resolves App auth. Requires owner role; requires at least one field and a persistable config source path.

500.description: Config not persisted (no source path) or write/save failure

get.description: Reports, per tracked config field, which layer (seed / dashboard overlay / agent overlay / env) won and whether that layer is writable, plus overlay-rejection and GitHub-identity-consistency diagnostics. Requires owner role.
Returns the top-level review config (Config.Review) verbatim; not owner-gated for reads.

put.description: Updates review-gate settings; every field is nilable so an absent key leaves that setting untouched. Requires owner role.

get.description: Returns operator-defined template/config variables (name, type, scope, non-secret provenance hint), plus whether exec/http variable security is enabled. Not owner-gated for reads.

put.summary: Create or update an operator variable
put.description: Creates/updates a single static or env variable (script/http are seed-only and rejected with 403). Rejects static values that look like secrets. Requires owner role.

400.description: Invalid name/type/scope, or value looks like a secret

403.description: script/http variables can only be defined in the seed config

delete.description: Deletes a static/env variable (script/http are seed-managed and cannot be deleted here). Requires owner role.

403.description: script/http variables cannot be deleted from the dashboard

get.summary: Get unified estimated + native cost view
get.description: Returns the estimated cost breakdown (from token counts x list prices) plus per-gateway native metered cost (OpenRouter/LiteLLM) and merged-PR/closed-issue counts. Not owner-gated.
Returns the recorded cost-history samples (same data source as the unified /api/timeseries?series=cost).
Returns the configured hive ID (empty if unset). Not owner-gated.

put.description: Sets and persists the hive display ID to /data/hive-id (max 64 chars, alphanumeric/space/hyphen/underscore only). Requires owner role.

400.description: Missing id, too long, or invalid characters

get.summary: List available models for an inference backend
get.description: Discovers models from the backend's configured endpoints; falls back to a static alias list (flagged) if discovery finds nothing.

partial.description: True when some but not all endpoints answered.

get.description: Returns recent lifecycle events plus fleet-health rollups, optionally filtered by the hive's ACMM level. Never returns null arrays.

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Fleet-health look-back window in minutes; default timeline.DefaultFleetWindow.

get.description: Returns delivered kick prompts within a time window, optionally filtered by agent. Fails closed like /api/audit: requires at least read-write role (prompt bodies embed repo names, issue titles, and knowledge content).
Returns the last known per-provider headroom snapshot from the credential rotation manager. Requires owner role. Reports enabled=false with an empty provider list when rotation is disabled.
Returns the audit-fact-derived activity snapshot (phase 1: counts only, no cost attribution) plus known limitations of the sampling window.

Returns the cached repo-cost collector snapshot (interval join of audit facts and usage events). Reports ready=false with an explicitly empty by_repo (never a fabricated $0.00) before the collector's first tick.

get.summary: Get the current caller's role and identity
get.description: Resolves the caller's live role/username (from session, hub-proxy headers, or a bare X-Hive-Role/X-Hive-User pair; empty role defaults to owner) plus the configured auto-merge label and optional display name.

post.description: Proxies a POST to the hub's /api/saas/hives/{hiveID}/upgrade endpoint, relaying the caller's identity/cookie and this spoke's dashboard-token proof. Requires owner role. Response is passed through verbatim from the hub with its original status code.

400.description: Hub URL/hive ID not configured, or no dashboard-token proof available

get.description: Returns the full cached status object for public snapshot embedding, gated on hub.auto_snapshot being enabled. Cacheable for 60s.
Returns the configured list of origins allowed to iframe the snapshot page (CSP frame-ancestors allowlist).

Returns sanitized custom CSS for a given source/scope. By default responds as text/css; when `report=1` is passed, responds as JSON with the source key, CSS text, and a sanitize report (dropped-rule count etc).

parameters.name: report
parameters.description: When '1', return JSON with source/css/report instead of raw CSS.

200.description: CSS text, or JSON when report=1

get.description: Alias over the dedicated sparkline history endpoints, selected via the `series` query param.

200.description: Series data (shape matches the corresponding dedicated endpoint)

get.summary: Get the gh CLI token-access audit log
get.description: Returns the most recent entries from the token-access log (every gh CLI command an agent issued, including full arguments). Requires owner role.

error.description: Present when the log file could not be read.

get.description: Returns the recorded trend-history samples (same data source as /api/timeseries — trend series is not exposed there, but this dedicated endpoint always is).

post.summary: Queue a pull request for auto-merge
post.description: Applies the configured auto-merge label to a PR on behalf of the authenticated user, after verifying the repo is managed by this hive and the caller is not the PR's own author. Requires merger or owner role.

403.description: Not authenticated, self-authored PR, or repo not managed by this hive

get.description: Returns a compact summary (governor mode, queued issues/PRs, running/paused agent counts, last eval time) for an embeddable status widget.

post.description: Fire-and-forget beacon: records the authenticated (X-Hive-User only) caller as actively engaged when the tab is visible and had recent input. Unidentified callers are a silent no-op. Malformed bodies are treated as not-engaged.

get.summary: Outcome of the most recent kick
get.description:
Read-only; any authenticated role. Reports whether the most recent asynchronous kick reached the agent's CLI (kubestellar/hive#5325). This is where kick success or failure is decided — POST /api/kick only promises the message was queued.

While status is "in-flight" the outcome is INDETERMINATE: the prompt may still be delivered, and a client must not render it as a failure. "unknown" means no asynchronous kick has been dispatched for this agent in the current process lifetime, which is not an error.

pending.description: True while the outcome is indeterminate.

error.description: Failure reason; present only when status is failed.
